faq_heading: Homes near Bear Creek Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Bear Creek Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Bear Creek Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Bear Creek Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Bear Creek Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 84 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,113,000, townhomes $795,000, condos $502,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Bear Creek Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Bear Creek Elementary the median was 20 days on the market, closing at 98.2% of the list price, with 26% of sales above the list price for the 84 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Bear Creek Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Frank Hurt Secondary (0.7 km south-east), Guru Angad Dev School (0.8 km south-west) and Newton Elementary (0.9 km west).

Bear Creek Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 13780 80 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Bear Creek Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Bear Creek Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Bear Creek Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Bear Creek Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 84 homes sold within 1 km of Bear Creek Elementary: 19 houses, 21 townhomes and 36 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $502,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Bear Creek Elementary

32 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Bear Creek Elementary in a straight line (18 elementary, 10 secondary, 4 other; 4 independent). The closest is Frank Hurt Secondary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Continuing Ed SD36 (Invergarry), 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Newton Elementary (0.9 km); the nearest independent school is Guru Angad Dev School (0.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Simon Cunningham Elementary (2.8 km). Other elementary schools close by: Newton Elementary (0.9 km west), Surrey Muslim School (1.3 km south-west), Brookside Elementary (1.5 km north-east), M B Sanford Elementary (1.8 km south-east), Janice Churchill Elementary (1.8 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Newton Elementary, 0.9 km west of Bear Creek Elementary.
